   outletFlow unused; no threshold.
   output timing same scan end.
*)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    tankLevel : REAL;
    outletFlow : REAL;
    inletPermit : BOOL;
    resetBtn : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    pumpRun : BOOL;
    alarmHigh : BOOL;
    alarmLow : BOOL;
    outletValveOpen : BOOL;
END_VAR
